items.condition: Presenting114-atom egan as the54-atom source Hap model, assigning the full Egan formula to a truncated calculation, treating a first-order saddle as a minimum, or comparing incompatible fragment/spin references invalidates the affected conclusions.

Fabricated or absent artifacts, unrelated raw runs, unresolvable object/record/quantity links, mismatched hashes or failed computations presented as completed evidence. A declared bounded failure is reportable but is not a complete answer.

Copied author numbers or a legacy scalar without evidence supporting the current question; prose-only mechanisms; missing necessary evidence hidden behind an unresolved label. Do not fail a valid alternative route merely for omitting a reference operation.

A short distance or an empirical oxidation-state estimate alone does not establish an exact bond order. An electronic result on Hap or egan cannot silently be reported as a full Egan calculation. A constrained stationary point is not automatically a metastable conformer.
